<thought>From the measurements the circuit is a series chain A‑N_a1‑N_a2‑N_a3‑N_b1‑N_b2‑N_c1‑N_c2‑B with resistors R1…R8. Additional nodes X1 and X2 create three delta (triangle) groups:
- Δ between N_a3, X1, N_b1 (20 Ω, 10 Ω, 30 Ω)
- Δ between N_b2, X2, N_c1 (20 Ω, 25 Ω, 30 Ω)
- Δ between N_c2, X1, X2 (70 Ω, 25 Ω, 45 Ω)

All other measured resistances are sums of these elementary resistors, confirming the topology. The resistor values (Ω) are:
R1=5, R2=10, R3=15, R4=30, R5=15, R6=30, R7=15, R8=20,
R9=20, R10=10, R11=20, R12=25, R13=70, R14=25, R15=45.
